prompt:
The section file sections/video-embed-fallbacks.liquid currently outputs every setting raw. It always shows the heading, iframe and caption, even when settings are null or blank. Rewrite the markup above the {% schema %} block so it follows the rules below. Keep the schema block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs (all under section.settings; there are no top-level inputs): - section.settings.heading: string or null - section.settings.video_id: string or null - section.settings.caption: string or null - section.settings.autoplay: boolean or null (null means false) - section.settings.start_minutes: non-negative integer or null (null counts as 0) - section.settings.start_seconds: non-negative integer or null (null counts as 0) Normalization: heading, video_id and caption are trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace. A null value counts as an empty string. A value that is empty after trimming is treated as absent. Output order: 1. Always open with
. 2. If the heading is present, output

HEADING

, where HEADING is the trimmed, HTML-escaped heading. 3. If video_id is present: - Output
. There is no space between ID and PARAMS; it appears above only for readability. - ID is the trimmed, HTML-escaped video_id. - TITLE is the trimmed, HTML-escaped heading, or the literal text Video when the heading is absent. - Build PARAMS from up to two parts, in this order: a) when autoplay is true: autoplay=1&mute=1 b) when start_minutes*60 + start_seconds is greater than 0: start=N, where N is that total in seconds. Join the parts with &. Prefix the result with ?. PARAMS is empty when there are no parts. - Then, only if the caption is present, output

CAPTION

with the trimmed, HTML-escaped caption. 4. If video_id is absent, output

Video coming soon

instead of the frame. Never output the caption in this case. 5. Close with
. Whitespace and escaping: - Output no whitespace or newlines between tags. - HTML escaping converts & < > " to & < > ". - Use only core Liquid; this is rendered with strict variables. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/video-embed-fallbacks.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
